meta.title: Archive Manager
meta.description: Archive, restore, favorite, and permanently delete sessions, and diagnose damaged session logs.

en.archiveActive.desc: u201C{name}u201D still has work in progress: {kinds}. Archiving stops that work first.
en.archiveActive.title: Stop and archive
en.archived.notOpenable: This session is archived. Unarchive it to continue the conversation.
en.archives.archiveProject: Archive all chats in this project
en.archives.archiveProjectDesc: Archive all {n} unarchived sessions in u201C{name}u201D, regardless of the current search filter. You can restore them in Archived.
en.archives.archiveSelectedDesc: Archive the selected sessions, including selections hidden by the current filter. You can view and restore them in Archived.
en.archives.archiveUngroupedDesc: Archive all {n} ungrouped, unarchived sessions, regardless of the current search filter. You can restore them in Archived.
en.archives.archiveUnknown: This session no longer exists, so it cannot be archived.
en.archives.deletePartial: Deleted {deleted} chats and cleared {skipped} stale archive entries; {failed} could not be deleted: {detail}
en.archives.deleteProject: Delete all chats in this project
en.archives.deleteProjectDesc: This permanently deletes the {n} archived chats in {name}, their child agents, and their records. The project directory and unarchived chats are not affected. This cannot be undone.
en.archives.deleteSelectedDesc: This permanently deletes the selected {n} archived chats, their child agents (including any that are still running), and their records. Other chats are not affected. This cannot be undone.
en.archives.deleteSkipped: Cleared {n} stale archive entries for sessions that no longer exist.
en.archives.deleteSuccessWithSkipped: Deleted {deleted} archived chats and cleared {skipped} stale archive entries for sessions that no longer exist.
en.archives.deleteUngroupedDesc: This permanently deletes the {n} ungrouped archived chats, their child agents, and their records. Other projects and unarchived chats are not affected. This cannot be undone.
en.archives.description: Manage archived sessions or select unarchived sessions to archive in bulk.
en.archives.navigationUnavailable: This host cannot keep the conversation archived while opening it. Use u201CRestore and openu201D instead.
en.archives.restoreBatchFailed: Could not restore the archived chats: {detail}
en.archives.restoreProject: Restore all chats in this project
en.archives.selectionHiddenHint: Includes {hidden} hidden by the current filter; actions apply to them too.
en.archives.sessionNotRetained: The host did not keep the requested conversation open. Try again, or restore it before opening.
en.archives.title: Archived sessions
en.archives.unarchiveUnknown: This session no longer exists, so it cannot be unarchived.
en.archiveWorkspace.desc: This archives all conversations in u201C{name}u201D. You can find them later in Archived sessions.
en.archiveWorkspace.title: Archive {n} conversations?
en.conflict.named: A workspace named u201C{name}u201D already exists.
en.copy.denied: Copy failed. Allow clipboard access and retry.
en.copy.unavailable: Clipboard unavailable. Open the page over HTTPS or localhost.
en.delete.desc: This removes u201C{name}u201D from the workspace list. The folder and session logs will be kept. Its sessions will appear under Ungrouped.
en.deleteSession.desc: This permanently deletes session u201C{name}u201D, its child agents (including any that are still running), and all of its records (conversation, stats, cache). This cannot be undone.
en.deleteSession.title: Delete session
en.deleteSession.unknown: This session no longer exists or was already deleted.
en.details.failed: Could not read turns for {n} sessions
en.details.hint: User submissions; excludes tool calls and injected messages
en.details.noPath: The host did not provide a session path
en.details.notReturned: The host did not return session details
en.discovery.earlier: More messages before this preview. Open the full conversation to read them.
en.discovery.empty: No user or assistant text to preview.
en.discovery.invalidDate: Check the date range: the start must not be after the end.
en.discovery.later: More messages after this preview. Open the full conversation to read them.
en.discovery.previewHint: Read-only original conversation text; keeps the conversation archived. Excludes tools, attachments, reasoning and system content.
en.discovery.searchError: Content search is incomplete; results may be missing.
en.discovery.truncated: Only part of this message is shown.
en.folderError.title: Couldnu2019t open folder
en.groupBy.label: Group by
en.health.blocked.advice: Expand technical details to see the restriction. Resolve it before diagnosing again.
en.health.corrupt.advice: Keep the existing log and check the disk and original files. Messages will not be truncated or deleted automatically.
en.health.corrupt.reason: The session log may be corrupt or incomplete
en.health.failed.advice: Expand technical details to inspect the error. Resolve it before diagnosing again.
en.health.heading: Diagnosis and repair
en.health.healthy.advice: Refresh the session details. No repair is needed.
en.health.healthy.reason: The session can be read normally
en.health.legacy-source.advice: Run a diagnosis to check whether the legacy source can be converted.
en.health.legacy-source.reason: The new DSH version does not support this legacy message source
en.health.missing.advice: Check the original directory and disk. Rebuilding the cache cannot recover missing messages.
en.health.missing.reason: The session log or attachment path does not exist
en.health.notice: Session repaired. Details have been refreshed.
en.health.permission.advice: Check directory permissions, file locks and security software, then retry.
en.health.permission.reason: Permission to read the session files was denied
en.health.published-unreadable.advice: The original log is preserved. Restart DSH and diagnose again. Do not repeatedly repair or delete logs.
en.health.published-unreadable.reason: A new log was generated, but the host could not read it back
en.health.ready-frame.advice: Correct the compression frames, preserving messages and the original log. Ensure no other DSH process has the session open.
en.health.ready-frame.reason: Found compression frame issues from a previous repair; host validation passed
en.health.ready.advice: Rewrite the sources to a host-supported plugin attribution and generate a new log, preserving messages and the original log. Ensure no other DSH process has the session open.
en.health.ready.reason: Found {n} legacy sources; host format validation passed
en.health.repair-frame.advice: Run a diagnosis to correct the compression frames while preserving the original log.
en.health.repair-frame.reason: A previous repair used an unsupported compression format
en.health.repaired.advice: The original log and archive status are preserved. You can preview or open the session again.
en.health.repaired.reason: Repair complete; the host can read the session
en.health.scopeArchived: Checks all archived sessions, regardless of list filters.
en.health.scopeUnarchived: Checks all unarchived sessions, regardless of list filters. Archive and close a session before repairing it.
en.health.unknown.advice: Retry first. If it still fails, expand technical details to check host compatibility.
en.health.unknown.reason: The session cannot currently be read
en.orderBy.label: Order by
en.organizer.idleConfirm: Review and deselect candidates. Favorites and active sessions are checked again before archiving.
en.organizer.manualConfirm: Only checked sessions below will be archived. You can undo this batch afterward.
en.organizer.result: Succeeded {succeeded} xB7 Skipped {skipped} xB7 Failed {failed} xB7 Unprocessed {remaining}
en.organizer.rules: Uses last activity, the current list filters. Excludes favorites, open, running and waiting sessions.
en.organizer.undoHint: Only the latest archive batch while this page is open is retained. Closing or refreshing clears undo. Deleted sessions cannot be restored.

en.search.hasMore: Showing the first {n} results. Narrow your search.
